source: Frac(x) = x - Floor(x); Floor(-π) = -4, so Frac(-π) = 4 - π
caption: An exact irrational input: the branch is decided numerically, but the result stays exact
A huge exact argument stays unevaluated: a double can't resolve 10^20·π's fractional part to certify a branch, so this declines rather than risk a wrong one
